`requirements.md` has been generated and accepted at `.sdlc/runs/20261104-093718-feature-new-home-unread-notifs/requirements.md`.

### Summary of Contents
- **In scope (1–7)**: Testable items covering `UnreadNotificationsCard`, new-frontend-system widget registration (`HomePageWidgetBlueprint`), translations, `?id=` deep-link row highlighting in `NotificationsPage`/`NotificationsTable`, app-context-free `CardExtension` rendering in `@backstage/plugin-home-react`, jsdom unit tests, docs, API reports, and changesets.
- **Out of scope (1–5)**: Non-goals from the brief, including backend/storage/endpoint changes, old-frontend-system card extension exports, `app-config.yaml`/example-app changes, sibling package modifications, and off-limits paths.
- **Functional requirements (FR-1 to FR-7)**: Grouped by `plugins/notifications` (FR-1 through FR-6) and `plugins/home-react` (FR-7).
- **Non-functional requirements (NFR-1 to NFR-7)**: Repository rules covering 2026 Apache 2.0 headers, package style consistency, `screen` + `findBy*` testing rules without test IDs, hand-written per-package `patch` changesets without internal symbols, doc style guide compliance, API report regeneration commands, and forbidden commands.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Data sensitivity/protection table and role × resource × action authorization matrix.
- **Acceptance criteria (AC-1 to AC-9)**: Executable criteria covering jsdom tests, unmount cleanup, `?id=` deep-link highlighting, `home-react` rendering without app context, API report checks, and the Gate 0 verification command.
- **Open questions for HITL (1–4)**: Default card item limit, polling interval, empty-state presentation, and deep-link filter behavior.
